arms.E1: enrichment at 1 kb for A. baumannii genomes whose sequence type is not 2, with Klebsiella and P. aeruginosa unchanged
arms.E2: E1 restricted further to occurrences that are not composite-flanked, so both alternative explanations are removed at once

decision_rule.effect_is_GC2_specific_if: non-ST2 A. baumannii enrichment falls below 8.46, or the A. baumannii / Klebsiella ratio falls below 1.5
decision_rule.reported_regardless: both arms and the occurrence counts, whatever they show
decision_rule.thresholds_reused_from: NM-C1-006, deliberately, rather than chosen now

estimator: unchanged; observed and expected read from the saved null matrices c1_4_matrices.npz, subset by column
raised_by: the owner's decision framework: whether the effect holds in non-ST2 A. baumannii decides where this paper goes
title: Genome-wide enrichment with the GC2 lineage removed
